contentPattern.structure: vertical nested list of section links: parent link + bold active current-section link (with accent bar + collapse chevron) + indented child-page links

suitableFor: left-hand vertical section-navigation sidebars on two-column pages (sidebar-listing, sidebar-article, sidebar-faq and related templates)
hierarchical in-section navigation with a parent, an active current section, and child-page links
the identical left sidebar shared by all sidebar-listing pages including the FAQ pages
notSuitableFor: expandable FAQ Q&A (use an accordion variant)

notes: NEW variant for the sidebar-listing template. No existing sidebar / section-navigation block existed in the project; nearest neighbor cards-minimal-dark-iconnav is horizontal and icon-based (0% structural match). Built on the cards base per the project convention for nav blocks. Authoring model: one row per nav item; when two cells are present the first cell is a level token (parent | current | child) and the second holds the link, otherwise a single-cell row is treated as a flat child link. decorate() builds a nested <ul>, marks the current item (explicit 'current' token or href matching the page path) with an accent bar and a collapse chevron, and nests child links under it. The same sidebar is reused across all 14 sidebar-listing pages (article listing pages and FAQ pages).
